description:
Scope: planning only; add/modify tests solely at test/zaq/engine/history_delivery_worker_test.exs for lib/zaq/engine/history_delivery_worker.ex lines 20, 24, 27. No production changes, new support modules, E2E tests, or Git changes. This issue remains open for implementation.

Functional specification and tests to add before implementation (only tests are planned):
1. Line 20, missing durable confirmation: execute the real HistoryDeliveryWorker via perform_job(HistoryDeliveryWorker, %{"message_id" => Ecto.UUID.generate()}) in the existing Zaq.DataCase + Oban.Testing module. With no matching Message row, HistoryIngress.associate_confirmation/1 yields {:error, :missing_confirmation}; assert {:cancel, :missing_confirmation}. Also use an existing unconfirmed Message only if a minimal existing fixture makes it cheap; do not build a full delivery just to exercise absence. Assert no message/transcript association or new recovery job is created as appropriate. This is terminal cancellation, not a retry.
2. Line 24, exception normalization: arrange an actual confirmed canonical Message and enabled connector through existing HistoryIngress.record_confirmation/1 + incoming/admission/finalization fixture pattern from test/zaq/engine/history_ingress_test.exs (around its admission-confirmation test) or test/zaq/engine/conversations/canonical_history_capture_test.exs (around its confirmation retry test). Confirm a single ID-only Oban job with %{"message_id" => assistant_id}; preserve valid durable delivery_confirmation and connector scope. Then deliberately corrupt ONLY the persisted private history_association.transcript_ids to [] using Message.confirmation_changeset/2 and Repo.update!/1 in the sandbox, retaining other metadata. HistoryIngress.associate_confirmation/1 reaches TranscriptHistory.associate_prepared/2 whose nonempty-list function head raises FunctionClauseError; perform_job(HistoryDeliveryWorker, %{"message_id" => assistant_id}) must return {:error, :history_association_unavailable} (line 24), not crash or re-deliver. Verify delivery_confirmation and job args remain unchanged; no TranscriptMessage association is inserted. Explicitly document the corrupted-data fixture as recovery-boundary fault injection, never a legitimate production confirmation. If this invalid metadata cannot be persisted or does not raise on actual code, first inspect the failure, then use another minimal persisted corrupt target that raises from the real association path; do not mock HistoryIngress, add test-only hooks, mutate globally configured Repo, or claim coverage without proving line 24.
3. Line 27, invalid/legacy payloads: table of concrete %Oban.Job{args: ...} values: %{} (missing ID), %{"message_id" => valid_id, "extra" => "legacy"} (payload-bearing job), %{"message_id" => nil} (wrong ID type); optionally %Oban.Job{args: %{"content" => "legacy"}}. Assert perform/1 returns {:cancel, :unconfirmed_delivery} in each case; assert no canonical message association/job insertion. Valid ID-only absent Message belongs to scenario 1, not this guard. No need to construct deliveries for invalid payloads.

Fixtures, assertions, mocks, isolation: reuse existing Zaq.DataCase async: true, Oban.Testing repo: Zaq.Repo, Ecto.UUID.generate/0, and the existing connector/person/incoming/confirmation arrangement in nearby tests; introduce only a small local helper after duplication justifies it. Retain per-test unique IDs and SQL Sandbox ownership. perform_job executes synchronously in the test process; no child database access, app-env mutation, global Mox mode, sleeps, timers, polling, or external requests. Internal HistoryIngress, TranscriptHistory, Repo and Oban stay real; no mock needed. Assert exact cancel/error tuples and persisted durable evidence, not private function invocation. Existing successful/retry coverage in canonical_history_capture_test.exs:578-583 should remain intact; avoid duplicating it. No new feature journey or UX change: E2E not applicable.

Property assessment: not warranted for this finite three-way job-shape/terminal-result contract; focused examples exercise each meaningful branch. If payload schema later becomes combinatorial or a security-default invariant appears, reconsider a bounded property alongside examples.

Action reuse assessment: not applicable; testing existing worker contract only, no operation, Action, tool, workflow Step or API being designed/changed. Production ownership remains HistoryIngress for recovery and HistoryDeliveryWorker for scheduling only (engine service policy). Documentation updates: none; this issue is the durable coverage plan. Unreachable blocker: if the real rescue path cannot be triggered by controlled persisted data through the public worker call without changing production semantics or test-only seams, mark line 24 as infeasible and report the exact exception/result and options for human decision rather than introducing an internal mock solely for coverage.

Validation on later implementation (not in this planning assignment): run isolated mix test test/zaq/engine/history_delivery_worker_test.exs and the affected canonical_history_capture_test.exs through Context Mode; run mix q, inspect diff and ensure existing assertions remain strong. At post-review coverage phase generate fresh mix coveralls.json (600000 ms) then mix coverup only on success, verify missed lines; follow final mix precommit (900000 ms) gate before requesting approval. Never count a line as covered based solely on planned inputs. No tests or Git commands run during this planning task.

comments.text: Implementation update: added worker-level missing-confirmation cancellation and malformed/legacy payload assertions (missing args, extra key, nil ID) in test/zaq/engine/history_delivery_worker_test.exs. Line 24 rescue-path fixture was not added: deliberately corrupting persisted confirmed metadata to force an exception is fault injection into an unreachable/inconsistent state, disallowed by parent scope's no forced unreachable seam constraint; no legitimate persisted-data exception was found. Rescue coverage remains blocked for human decision.
